spec.denominator: mean balance of SURVIVING loans (balance > 0) in the frozen sample
spec.denominator_note: the all-loan mean averages in prepaid loans at zero balance and would roughly double the implied count; a payoff retires a live balance
spec.sigma_note: SOMA share of 1-4 family mortgage debt is NOT a committed artifact of this repo, so the gross-up is a bracket, not a point
spec.s1_is_upper_bound: s=1 is the production convention: all voluntary gap response is treated as the moving channel, so the count is an upper bound on the moving component

comparator.note: annualized SAAR monthly observations averaged over 2025; this account returns no pre-2025 history for this series, which is why the 2022-2024 decline comparison is not computed

not_computed.share_of_2022_2024_decline: NOT COMPUTED. fonseca2026 (NBER 35237) verifies a 40% drop in U.S. existing home sales between 2022 and 2024, but as a percentage; this account returns no pre-2025 history for EXHOSLUSM495S, so the 2022 level cannot be sourced. Deriving it would require assuming 2024 ~ 2025, an assumption this run declines to make.
